test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Find the value of sin (50 + θ) - cos (40 - θ).
solution:
Formula used:

sin(90-θ) = cos θ

cos(90-θ) = sin θ

Calculation:

sin (50° +θ) - cos (40° - θ)

= sin( 90 - (40 -θ)) - cos(40 - θ) 

= cos(40 -θ) - cos(40- θ) 

= 0

∴ The correct answer is 0.
